messages.author: d65d060be3790aca
messages.subject: Variable Survey Lengths
parts:
Hi all,

Just wondering if there is any issue with applying distsampOpen to data with variable survey lengths, including survey duration as a covariate on detection probability. I can't see anywhere explicitly saying this would be inappropriate, but wanted to consult the group before I went ahead.

Thanks very much,
Rory

messages.author: 4a15de51da4445ae
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Variable Survey Lengths
parts:
hi Rory,
 I think this is a reasonable thing to do.  The model allows observation covariates on the log(sigma) scale (sigma the scale parameter of the distance function), and it seems reasonable to me that sigma should increase with survey duration.
regards
andy
